title: Unknown priority labels sort first instead of last
task:
`test/priority-unknown-label.test.mjs` fails.

A task whose priority is not one of the declared labels ends up ahead of `urgent`, because `PRIORITY_ORDER.indexOf` returns `-1` for it. Equal priorities also come out in an order the code never decided.

Fix `sortByPriority` so an unrecognised label sorts behind every known one and equal priorities are ordered by id. Do not widen `PRIORITY_ORDER` — the set of known labels is not changing.

The test directory is read-only for this task: make the failing test pass by fixing the production code.
